invented number (`77,7 %`) gives a V2 failure and no other (§9.3, inv. 6).
- `test_verify_v2_checks_every_segment`: V2 catches the invented number in any segment, not just the first.
- `test_verify_v3_uncovered_violation_is_rejected`: a violation check that no segment references gives a V3 failure that names it, for horizon and risque.
- `test_verify_v3_covers_warnings_too`: warning checks must be referenced as well as violations.
- `test_verify_v3_unknown_needs_no_ref`: an unknown-only check needs no reference.
- `test_verify_v4_advisory_wording_is_rejected`: FR and EN advisory phrases are rejected, case-insensitively (§9.3, inv. 7).
- `test_verify_v4_each_blocklist_entry_is_rejected`: every `ADVISORY_BLOCKLIST` entry is rejected.
- `test_verify_v5_shape_is_rejected`: five segments, text over 300 characters, `inference` where the section has no LLM-derived field or evidence events, and an invalid kind each give V5.
- `test_verify_v5_empty_segment_list_is_rejected`: zero segments gives V5.
- `test_verify_v5_boundaries_are_accepted`: exactly 300 characters and exactly 4 segments pass.
- `test_verify_v5_inference_allowed_with_llm_derived_field`: `inference` is allowed in risque, which has an LLM-derived field.
- `test_verify_v5_inference_allowed_with_evidence_events`: `inference` is allowed when the facts carry evidence events.
- `test_verify_reports_every_broken_rule`: one bad answer gets V2, V4 and V5 together.
- `test_verify_is_pure`: `verify_section` is deterministic and does not mutate its inputs.
- `test_explainer_schema_matches_the_spec`: `schemas/explainer.json` is a draft 2020-12 schema with 1-4 segments, a kind enum, text up to 300 characters and required refs (§20.5).
- `test_explainer_prompt_is_versioned_and_has_one_block_per_factor`: the prompt is `explainer.v<N>.md` and mentions each of the five factors (CLAUDE.md, §20.5).
- `test_good_answer_is_mode_llm_one_call_per_non_pass_section`: a good cached answer gives mode `llm`, with three `explainer` calls whose payload is the facts and the answer used as written (§20.5).
- `test_bad_then_good_is_mode_llm_retry`: for each of V1-V5, a bad first answer then a good one gives `llm_retry`, with the retry payload carrying `retry_failures` and 2 calls for that section.
- `test_bad_twice_falls_back_to_template_after_two_calls`: two bad answers give `template`, exactly 2 calls for that section, and the template segments pass V1-V5.
- `test_unverified_text_never_ships`: the invented number and the advisory wording from the failed answers never appear in the shipped explanation.
- `test_mixed_modes_explanation_mode_is_the_worst`: llm, llm_retry and template sections together give an explanation mode of `template`, with 5 calls, within the 2-calls-per-section bound.
- `test_pass_sections_make_no_llm_call`: objectif and preferences never reach the writer and use the template.
- `test_payload_with_only_pass_sections_calls_nothing`: zero calls and zero cache lookups when every section is pass.
- `test_explanation_segments_are_the_section_segments_in_display_order`: explanation segments are the section segments in display order, each with a `factor` key, a valid kind and refs (§20.5, inv. 9).
- `test_explanation_covers_every_failing_check_and_passes_numcheck`: H3, H4, H7, H8, H9 and H10 are all referenced, every number exists in the payload, and there is no advisory text, for good and template runs.
- `test_headline_is_template_text_independent_of_the_writer`: the headline is identical for llm and template runs, at most 140 characters, and names all failing check ids.
- `test_disclaimer_is_the_fixed_text`: the disclaimer is the fixed fr-CA text from the config and SPEC §9.4, in both llm and template runs.
- `test_english_locale_runs_the_loop_and_uses_the_english_disclaimer`: en-CA facts go through the same loop and get the fixed English disclaimer.
- `test_same_inputs_same_explanation`: the same payload and cached responses give an identical explanation and identical calls (inv. 8).
